test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 2 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is the correct sequence of crops in the decreasing order of their production in India in 2019-20?
solution:
The correct option is __**Rice-wheat-coarse cereals-pulses.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• India ranks** second** worldwide in farm outputs.
 
• Agriculture sector contributed **17–18%** to country's GDP in** 2018**.
 
• India is the **second-largest producer of wheat and rice** in the world.
 
• **West Bengal** is the largest producer of **rice** in India.
 
• **Uttar Pradesh** is the state with maximum production of **wheat**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **China** is the largest producer of **Rice** in the world.
 
• Largest producer of **Wheat is China** with **29%** of the total production in the world.
 
• **Cuba** is known as the **'Sugar Bowl of the world'.**
 
• **Darjeeling tea, Mysore betel leaf, Odisha rasgulla and Kashmir saffron** are some of the products which are given **GI tags** in India.
